stake_operation_occurred.meaning: increaseStake or decreaseStake was called on the Distributor contract during bonding

reward_recipient.meaning: address that receives the distributed reward tokens

staking_user.meaning: address of the staking user who is the intended reward recipient

assumptions: increaseStake/decreaseStake is invoked on the Distributor contract during bonding as the reward-distribution scenario.
The staking user's address is the intended recipient of rewards earned during bonding.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who calls increaseStake/decreaseStake or any authorization condition; the caller identity is not bound.

limitations: Only the direct impact rewards_sent_to_launchpad is formalized; rewards_locked and users_lose_rewards are deferred to future claims.
The Launchpad-as-msg.sender root cause is not encoded as a precondition; it is the mechanism behind the selected impact.
No prior stake or reward balance state is described, so no balance-level precondition is encoded.
